structure: Retain the previously sealed scientific model and implementation unchanged. Draw independent people from one fixed, unweighted mixture law: select an Hb band, then generate continuous paired measurements using its Gaussian copula and calibrated marginal quantiles. Calibration applies to population quantities, not realized sample moments. The supplied generated-only checks support retaining the implementation; they do not identify the missing within-band dependence.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Hb-band probabilities and ferritin depletion probabilities
parameter_provenance.use: Normalize the Hb counts [206,619,298] and use depleted counts [123,148,59] within those bands. This reproduces the evidence-community threshold table in the model population.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Hb means and SDs; ferritin geometric means and geometric SDs
parameter_provenance.use: Treat the reported rounded summaries as population calibration values for the conditional marginal distributions.

parameter_provenance.source: Author-nominated assumptions, qualitatively informed by Zhu et al. Table III
parameter_provenance.use: Represent stronger positive association at low Hb and attenuation at higher Hb. These numerical correlations are not reported estimates from either population.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Bounded-power Hb quantiles and two-slope lognormal ferritin quantiles
parameter_provenance.use: Provide positive continuous measurements matching the supplied conditional moments and ferritin depletion probabilities.

parameter_provenance.source: Zhu et al., separate 2004 Hebei population
parameter_provenance.use: Inform association direction and severity dependence only. Do not pool its biomarker levels with CHNS or substitute its adjusted OR for the requested crude OR.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted crude odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of hb_g_dl <12 among ferritin_ug_l <15 divided by the corresponding odds among ferritin_ug_l >=15.
requested_estimands.population_implication: The calibrated population OR is (123*710)/(83*207), approximately 5.083. Generated sample estimates fluctuate.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation of ranks of continuous, uncorrected hb_g_dl and ferritin_ug_l across all generated people.
requested_estimands.population_implication: Determined by the calibrated between-band differences and nominated within-band copulas; not identified by the supplied aggregates alone.

limitations: Most consequential remaining assumption: the nominated within-band copulas describe the unobserved continuous dependence. They materially affect Spearman correlation while leaving the calibrated crude OR unchanged.

Transport assumes evidence-community band frequencies and conditional distributions apply to other communities sampled under the same CHNS design. Community heterogeneity and survey clustering are not modeled.
The target includes complete-case women regardless of pregnancy or inflammation. No pregnancy exclusions, inflammation corrections, altitude adjustments, or survey weights are introduced.
Hb tail shapes are planning assumptions, with approximate overall support 7.6–20.7 g/dL. Ferritin tail shape is also assumed; neither is validated for extreme-tail clinical analyses.
Fixed calibration parameters omit uncertainty in the aggregate estimates and their transport. The external Hebei study does not resolve these uncertainties.
checks_actually_performed: Checked count consistency: Hb-band counts total 1,123, depleted counts total 330, and the upper two bands reproduce the 207 depleted and 710 nondepleted women without low Hb.
Calculated the evidence-community crude OR from Table 1 as approximately 5.083.
Algebraically checked the Hb quantile moment equations and the ferritin threshold and log-moment calibration equations.

Reviewed the supplied worker-generated checks: all four threshold-cell fractions differed from A by less than 0.0014; Hb-band means and SDs and ferritin geometric summaries remained close to their calibration values.
Noted the largest displayed ferritin geometric-SD discrepancy was 3.684 generated versus 3.607 in the low-Hb band. No parameters or seeds were changed to chase that finite-sample discrepancy.
No additional code execution, new generated-cohort testing, or evaluation-data access was performed in this review.
